macros.name: DeclareMicrotypeAlias
macros.doc: This can be used to set an alias name for a font, so that the file and the settings for the aliased font will be loaded.

macros.name: DeclareMicrotypeBabelHook
macros.doc: Declare the context that should be loaded when a babel language is selected.

macros.name: DeclareMicrotypeSet
macros.doc: This command declares a new set of fonts to which the micro-typographic extensions should be applied.

macros.name: DeclareMicrotypeSetDefault
macros.doc: This command can be used in the main configuration file to declare the default font set, in case no set is specified in the package options.

macros.name: DeclareMicrotypeSetDefault

macros.name: leftprotrusion
macros.doc: This command will add left protrusion for the following text.

macros.name: microtypecontext
macros.doc: This command may be used anywhere in the document (also in the preamble) to change the micro-typographic context in the current group.

macros.name: microtypesetup
macros.doc: In the document body, this command may be used to change the general settings of the micro-typographic extensions.

macros.name: SetProtrusion
macros.doc: The commands \SetExpansion and \SetProtrusion provide an interface for setting the character protrusion resp. expansion factors for a set of fonts.

macros.name: SetProtrusion

macros.name: textls
macros.doc: By default, each character will be spaced out by 50/1000em = 0.05em; this amount may be altered in the optional argument to \textls, using the \SetTracking command, or globally with the letterspace package option, with decreasing significance in this order.
